'''NRB''' is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[needle roller bearing|needle]] and cylindrical [[roller bearing]]s manufacturer, headquartered in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Shyam |first1=Ashutosh |title=Wheels of fortune turn for auto, put NRB Bearings in pole position |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/wheels-of-fortune-turn-for-auto-put-nrb-bearings-in-pole-position/articleshow/53495923.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=2 August 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nrbbearings.com/contactus/contactus.html |title=contact |publisher=Nrbbearings.com |accessdate=2010-10-02}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ebearing.com/news2003/022501.htm |title=eBearing News – NRB India Reports Timken Ownership Via Nadella, Torrington |publisher=Ebearing.com |date=25 February 2003 |accessdate=2010-10-02}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.equitymaster.com/research-it/company-info/comp_info.asp?h_CodeScrip=NRBB |title=NRB BEARINGS (530367 | NRBBEARING) – Stock Quote and Company Fact Sheet – Latest Results – Equitymaster India |publisher=Equitymaster.com |accessdate=2010-10-02}}</ref>

== History ==
NRB was incorporated in 1965 as an Indo-French venture with Nadella and pioneered the production of needle roller bearings in India. Its eight manufacturing facilities in India and Thailand produce needle roller bearings, cylindrical roller bearings, tapered roller bearings, special ball bearings, thrust bearings and other anti friction solutions such as planetary shafts and pins.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://business.mapsofindia.com/india-company/n/nrb-bearings.html |title=NRB Bearings |publisher=Business.mapsofindia.com |accessdate=2010-10-02}}</ref>

The company set up an engineering and design centre at its manufacturing unit in Thane in 2000. Today the facility has testing, validation and benchmarking capabilities.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dave |first1=Sachin |title=Lady with the right bearings |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/lady-with-the-right-bearings/articleshow/2458833.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=15 October 2007}}</ref>
